title: Past Simple vs Past Continuous (When/While)
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas cómo relatar historias e interrupciones en el pasado usando When y While.

parts.visual: Usamos el Past Continuous (was/were + ing) para una acción en progreso, y el Past Simple para una acción corta que la interrumpe. Conectores: WHEN (cuando) y WHILE (mientras).
parts.audio: We use the Past Continuous for an action in progress, and the Past Simple for a short action that interrupts it. Connectors: WHEN, meaning cuando, and WHILE, meaning mientras.

parts.visual: WHEN va seguido usualmente de Past Simple (la interrupción). Ej: I was typing an email WHEN the boss entered. WHILE va seguido usualmente de Past Continuous (la acción larga). Ej: The boss entered WHILE I was typing an email.
parts.audio: WHEN is usually followed by the Past Simple, which is the interruption. For example: I was typing an email WHEN the boss entered. WHILE is usually followed by the Past Continuous, which is the long action. For example: The boss entered WHILE I was typing an email.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma verbal correcta (Past Simple o Continuous) usando When y While.

questions.question: I ____ to the client WHEN the call dropped. (Estaba hablando).
questions.explanation: Acción larga (en progreso) antes del WHEN = Past Continuous (was talking).

questions.question: I was talking to the client WHEN the call ____. (Se cortó - Interrupción).
questions.explanation: La interrupción (después del WHEN) va en Past Simple (dropped).

questions.question: The power went out WHILE we ____ the presentation. (Estábamos haciendo).
questions.explanation: Después de WHILE usamos Past Continuous (were giving).

questions.question: ____ you checking your email WHEN the system crashed?
questions.explanation: Pregunta de Past Continuous con 'you' = Were you checking...?

questions.question: She ____ the document WHEN she noticed a mistake. (Estaba leyendo).
WHILE I ____ for the taxi, it started to rain. (Estaba esperando).
questions.explanation: Después de WHILE va la acción larga: was waiting.

questions.question: WHILE I was waiting for the taxi, it ____ to rain. (Empezó).
questions.explanation: La interrupción corta (Empezó a llover) va en Past Simple: started.

questions.question: What ____ you doing WHEN the fire alarm rang?
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre acción en proceso = What were you doing...?

questions.question: They were discussing the budget WHEN the CEO ____ the room. (Entró).
We ____ lunch WHEN the client arrived. (Estábamos teniendo/almorzando).
questions.explanation: Acción larga en progreso = were having.

questions.question: I lost my internet connection WHILE I ____ the file. (Estaba descargando).
I ____ my internet connection WHILE I was downloading the file. (Perdí).
questions.explanation: Acción corta en Past Simple (verbo irregular) = lost.

questions.question: Did you see the error WHILE you ____ the code? (Estabas revisando).
He was driving to work WHEN he ____ the news. (Escuchó).
WHILE they ____ the issue, they found another bug. (Estaban arreglando).
We were printing the reports WHEN the printer ____ down. (Se descompuso).
questions.explanation: Interrupción en Past Simple = broke down.

questions.question: Someone stole his laptop WHILE he ____ coffee. (Estaba comprando).
Someone ____ his laptop WHILE he was buying coffee. (Robó).
questions.explanation: Acción corta (interrupción/suceso) en Past Simple = stole.

questions.question: I ____ an important email WHEN the computer froze. (Estaba escribiendo).
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso antes del WHEN = was writing.

questions.question: I was writing an email WHEN the computer ____. (Se congeló).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el conector (when / while) o el verbo en pasado simple/continuo.

questions.question: I was typing ____ the phone rang. (Cuando)
____ I was typing, the phone rang. (Mientras)
I ____ talking WHEN the call dropped. (Estaba)
I was talking when the call ____. (dropped - interrupción)
WHILE we ____ giving the presentation, the power went out. (Estábamos)
She ____ reading WHEN she found a mistake. (Estaba)
WHILE I was waiting, it ____ to rain. (Empezó - start en pasado)
They were discussing WHEN the CEO ____. (Entró - enter en pasado)
I ____ my connection WHILE I was downloading. (Perdí - lose en pasado)
He was driving WHEN he ____ the news. (Escuchó - hear en pasado)

pairs.source: I was typing when he called
He called while I was typing
pairs.target: Él llamó mientras yo estaba escribiendo

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
